messages.content: Let's settle the flights for the Chicago arts weekend. Keep Friday through Monday, two travelers, the Saturday concert, and the Sunday museum visit as planned.

I have two workable Friday nonstops and two Monday returns. The Friday midday flight leaves Denver at 12:20 p.m., lands at O'Hare at 3:45 p.m., and is $418 per person round trip when paired with either return. The lower-cost flight leaves at 6:55 p.m., lands at Midway at 10:10 p.m., and brings the fare down to $346 per person.
How much usable time do we really gain Friday with the midday flight? Compare the airport transfers too, since we have not settled on the hotel.

From O'Hare, allow roughly 45 to 70 minutes to the downtown hotels under consideration, depending on traffic or train connections. You would likely arrive around 5:00 p.m., with time for dinner and an unhurried evening. From Midway, the transfer is usually about 30 to 50 minutes, but after baggage and the late arrival you would probably reach the hotel between 11:00 and 11:30 p.m. The late flight saves $144 total for two, but effectively gives up Friday evening.
That savings is not enough to make the first night a wash. Keep the midday flight in contention. What are the Monday choices?

The early nonstop departs O'Hare at 8:15 a.m. and arrives Denver at 10:05 a.m. You would need to leave the hotel around 5:30 a.m. The midafternoon nonstop departs Midway at 3:40 p.m. and arrives Denver at 5:25 p.m.; it costs $54 more per person and would let you have lunch downtown before heading to the airport.
Checkout will probably be around 11. Does the later flight still work without dragging our bags through lunch?

Yes. The hotel can hold both bags after checkout. You could check out around 10:45 a.m., leave the bags, have lunch, retrieve them near 12:45 p.m., and depart for Midway around 1:00 p.m. That should put you at the terminal close to 1:45 p.m., comfortably ahead of the 3:40 departure.
Put the full totals side by side: midday out with early return, and midday out with the later return.

For two travelers, the Friday midday flight plus Monday 8:15 a.m. return totals $836. Pairing the same outbound with the Monday 3:40 p.m. return totals $944. The additional $108 buys a normal Monday morning, lunch downtown, and about five more usable hours in Chicago, with bag storage required after checkout.
The later return seems worthwhile. Is there any concern about using O'Hare on arrival and Midway on departure?

Not for this itinerary. You are not transferring between airports on the same day, and each airport has a straightforward route to the hotel area. The only practical detail is checking the departure airport carefully on Monday before ordering transportation.
All right. Select the Friday 12:20 p.m. nonstop to O'Hare and the Monday 3:40 p.m. nonstop from Midway for both of us.

Selected for two travelers, pending payment, at a total airfare of $944. Friday arrival should put you downtown around 5:00 p.m., leaving the evening open before Saturday's concert. Sunday remains reserved for the museum. On Monday, plan to check out, store the bags, have lunch, retrieve them around 12:45 p.m., and leave for Midway near 1:00 p.m.
For seat selection, continue to request a window for me when one is available. That applies only to my seat; my spouse will choose their own. Can these fares be assigned now?

Yes. Seat selection is available before payment on both flights. I have requested an available window seat for you on each segment and left your spouse's seat unassigned for their choice. The Friday 12:20 p.m. Denver-to-O'Hare nonstop and Monday 3:40 p.m. Midway-to-Denver nonstop remain selected for both travelers at $944 total. Nothing has been charged yet.
